events.content:
Added a notification toggle to [the settings page](/workspace/app/page.tsx). The Server Action saves the preference in a cookie and calls Next.js’s `refresh()` from `next/cache`, so the page shows the new state without navigating elsewhere. I also added the [root layout](/workspace/app/layout.tsx) required to run the app.

The production build passes. I verified that toggling both on and off updates the rendered page, and each action returns without a redirect.

The starter has no account or database layer, so the preference is stored per browser rather than per signed-in account.

I also added the [root layout](/workspace/app/layout.tsx) required to run the app.

The production build passes. I verified that toggling both on and off updates the rendered page, and each action returns without a redirect.

The starter has no account or database layer, so the preference is stored per browser rather than per signed-in account.
